ENGLISH: I’m here- Whatever you are, I’m here!
What is all this? Where am I?
What is it you want to show me?
Finally. After so long I meet you, my promised student…
I come to offer you a place among the stars you have so diligently studied.
I am neither god nor demon, just a scientist, although I do offer you immortality…
Although my lessers had another name for it, you are in my prototype. I built this space.
You will, in due time, but not before I have shown you-
But you still have to reach the heart of this prototype.
